context.body: A chronology question becomes a present-tense identity claim and attempted stoning.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus honors the Father, promises life to those keeping his word, and closes the dispute by saying, “Before Abraham came into existence, I am.”
observations.label: Jesus says “I am” before Abraham: action

observations.body: Opponents accuse, question, invoke Abraham, and pick up stones.
observations.label: Jesus says “I am” before Abraham: response

observations.body: my Father · Abraham rejoiced · before Abraham · I am
observations.label: Words in John 8:48–59

payload.posture: Read John 8:48–59 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The phrase echoes divine self-reference, but the scene leaves readers to assess the force within John’s larger witness.
payload.title: Jesus says “I am” before Abraham
